author: evacfk
description: A multiplayer blackjack table with a shared shoe, seated players, and button-based hit/stand/double play.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no end-user data beyond what Red's core economy/bank system already stores (bet amounts pass through the bank API and are not separately retained by this cog).
install_msg: Blackjack table loaded. Run `.blackjackset settings` to see current config, `.blackjackset enabled true` to turn it on if it isn't already. The table itself (lobby/seating/gameplay) is still under active development.
